rv.q: But Evita remains, to me, his signature and defining dramatic masterpiece...

Emma Hatton charts this journey superbly. From the moment she appears – all flashing eyes and wanton ambition – she creates a character full of life and subtlety, rejecting the big effect for a smaller and more detailed reading of Evita's character.
The vitality and energy of the whole company match Lloyd Webbers music and together they drive the show.

cn.t: Critics praise this West End revival for showcasing Evita's fleet, robust construction and demonstrating it remains Lloyd Webber and Rice's finest collaboration, though "Don't Cry for Me Argentina" still dominates.
